A 1-inch sensor under 250 g

The first Mini with a 1-inch 50MP CMOS sensor — a 24mm f/1.8 lens in a 249.9 g body, shooting 4K/60fps HDR and 4K/120fps slow motion in 10-bit D-Log M.

LiDAR nightscape sensing

A forward-facing LiDAR unit backed by omnidirectional vision sensing detects obstacles in near-darkness, where purely optical sensing stops working.

36 minutes, 42GB on board

Up to 36 minutes on the standard battery — 52 minutes with the Plus battery — plus 42GB of built-in storage and a 225° rolling gimbal for true vertical shots.
